ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

11. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.

17. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

22. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Care PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Care for PRACTICES be able to; and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Toileting PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Food/ PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Plants ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Animals ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Weather ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
